summary: Your dog has never let you snooze: at six a.m., on four hours of sleep, you get up anyway, because it won't stop until you do. Your alarm stops with one tap, so you go back to sleep. Unsnooze rings until you're actually up: walk 50 steps, do 10 push-ups or shake it 40 times. Make your alarm as stubborn as your dog.
title: your dog has never let you snooze.
